title: FREK Registry Base Object
description: Common envelope fields shared by every FREK Registry namespace (Bloc 1 / Phase 2 FREK-ID base). Every namespace schema in this directory extends this shape via allOf.

frek_id.description: Canonical FREK-ID of this object (see Identity Engine, backend/identity_engine/service.py:generate_identity_id).

entity_type.description: FREK Registry namespace this object belongs to, e.g. 'frek.artist'.

owner_id.description: FREK-ID of the identity (Person/Organization) that owns/controls this object.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized object body (Proof Engine — see backend/passport/merkle.py:canonical_json).

public_key.description: base64/PEM public key associated with the issuer or owner, when applicable.
